# Tapir commands: Classification Commands

The 19 commands of this group, with their parameters, results and examples. Every group and how a command is sent: [commands.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands.md).

## Classification Commands

### GetClassificationsOfElements

Returns the classification of the given elements in the given classification systems. It works for subelements of hierarchal elements also.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.0.7. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetClassificationsOfElements

Parameters:

- `elements` (Elements, required)
- `classificationSystemIds` (ClassificationSystemIds, required)

Returns:

- `elementClassifications` (ElementClassificationsOrErrors, required): Order of the ids are the same as in the input. Non-existing elements or non-existing classification systems are represented by error objects.

Grasshopper: `GetClassificationsOfElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationsOfElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationsOfElements.py): Reads the classification of the first three Walls in every classification system with GetClassificationsOfElements. Needs at least one Wall.

### GetElementsByClassification

Returns the elements classified with the given classification items, one list per item, so elements can be filtered by classification in a single call.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetElementsByClassification

Parameters:

- `classificationItemIds` (ClassificationItemIds, required)

Returns:

- `elementsOfClassificationItems` (array of ClassificationItemElements or ErrorItem, required): The elements classified with each classification item, aligned with the input, or an error for a non-existing classification item.

Grasshopper: `GetElementsByClassificationComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetElementsByClassification.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetElementsByClassification.py): Lists the elements that are classified like the first Wall with GetElementsByClassification. Needs a classified Wall.

### SetClassificationsOfElements

Sets the classifications of elements. In order to set the classification of an element to unclassified, omit the classificationItemId field. It works for subelements of hierarchal elements also. With dryRun true nothing is changed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each item that passes the checks made before writing gets wouldChange, with the element's classification in the system now (oldValue) and the one a real run would set (newValue).

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.0.7. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetClassificationsOfElements

Parameters:

- `elementClassifications` (ElementClassifications, required)
- `dryRun` (DryRun)

Returns:

- `dryRun` (DryRunFlag)
- `executionResults` (ChangeExecutionResults, required): One result for each item of elementClassifications, in the order of the input. On a dry run an item that passes every check made before writing (the classification item and its system exist, the element's classification in that system can be read) gets wouldChange: oldValue is the element's classificationId in the system now and newValue the one a real run would set, both as GetClassificationsOfElements gives them (without classificationItemId when the element is or would be unclassified in the system). Archicad can still refuse an item that passes them.

Grasshopper: `SetClassificationsOfElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/SetClassificationsOfElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/SetClassificationsOfElements.py): Classifies the first Wall with the first item of the first classification system with SetClassificationsOfElements, then restores its classification. Needs at least one Wall and a classification system with an item.

### GetClassificationsOfAttributes

Returns the classifications of the given attributes (building materials, composites, surfaces, etc.) in every classification system they are classified in.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetClassificationsOfAttributes

Parameters:

- `attributeIds` (AttributeIds, required)

Returns:

- `attributeClassifications` (array of AttributeClassifications or ErrorItem, required): The classifications of the attributes, in the order of the input. A non-existing attribute is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `GetClassificationsOfAttributesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationsOfAttributes.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationsOfAttributes.py): Reads the classifications of the first three Building Materials in every classification system with GetClassificationsOfAttributes.

### SetClassificationsOfAttributes

Sets the classifications of attributes (building materials, composites, surfaces, etc.). The given item replaces the attribute's current item in the same classification system. In order to set the classification of an attribute to unclassified in a system, omit the classificationItemId field.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetClassificationsOfAttributes

Parameters:

- `attributeClassifications` (array of AttributeClassification, required): The classifications to set, one per attribute and classification system.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `SetClassificationsOfAttributesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/SetClassificationsOfAttributes.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/SetClassificationsOfAttributes.py): Classifies the first Building Material with the first item of the first classification system with SetClassificationsOfAttributes, then restores it. Needs a classification system with an item.

### GetClassificationOfAttributesInSystem

Returns the classification of the given attributes (for example Building Materials) in the given classification system. classificationItemId is omitted for an unclassified attribute.

Parameters:

- `attributeIds` (AttributeIds, required)
- `classificationSystemId` (ClassificationSystemId, required)

Returns:

- `attributeClassifications` (ClassificationIdsOrErrors, required): Order of the items is the same as in the input. classificationItemId is omitted when the attribute is unclassified in the system. Non-existing attributes or a non-existing classification system are represented by error objects.

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationOfAttributesInSystem.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationOfAttributesInSystem.py): Reads the classification of the first three Building Materials in the first classification system with GetClassificationOfAttributesInSystem.

### GetClassificationsOfElementDefaults

### GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults

Returns every classification of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types, in all classification systems at once. Unlike GetClassificationsOfElementDefaults it needs no list of classification systems; systems in which a default is unclassified are left out.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults

Parameters:

- `elementTypes` (array of ElementType, required): The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

Returns:

- `classificationsOfToolDefaults` (array of ToolDefaultClassifications or ErrorItem, required): The classifications of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the given element types. Invalid element types are represented by error objects.

Grasshopper: `GetClassificationsOfToolDefaultsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults.py): Reads every classification of the Wall, Slab and Column tool defaults in one call with GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults.

Returns the classification systems of the project with their guid, name, description, source, version and date. Same output as the official GetAllClassificationSystems command, so scripts can rely on Tapir commands only.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAllClassificationSystems

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `classificationSystems` (array of ClassificationSystemSummary, required): The classification systems of the project.

Grasshopper: `GetClassificationSystemsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetAllClassificationSystems.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetAllClassificationSystems.py): Lists the name, version and date of every classification system of the project with GetAllClassificationSystems.

### CreateClassificationSystems

Creates Classification Systems including Classification Items based on the given parameters.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateClassificationSystems

### DeleteClassificationSystems

Deletes the given Classification Systems. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each classification system that exists gets wouldDelete.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.2. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#DeleteClassificationSystems

Parameters:

- `classificationSystemIds` (ClassificationSystemIds, required)
- `dryRun` (DryRun)

Returns:

- `dryRun` (DryRunFlag)
- `executionResults` (DeletionExecutionResults, required): One result for each input classification system, in the order of the input. On a dry run a classification system that exists gets wouldDelete; Archicad can still refuse to delete one that exists.

Grasshopper: `DeleteClassificationSystemsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/DeleteClassificationSystems.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/DeleteClassificationSystems.py): Creates a temporary classification system and deletes it again with DeleteClassificationSystems.

Parameters:

- `classificationItems` (array of ClassificationItemUpdate, required): The classification items to update. Only the fields given change; items keep their guid and their parent.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `UpdateClassificationItemsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/UpdateClassificationItems.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/UpdateClassificationItems.py): Creates a classification item in a temporary system and changes its code and name with UpdateClassificationItems. The item keeps its guid, so the elements classified with it stay classified. The script deletes the temporary system at the end.

### ImportClassificationsXml

Imports a Classification Manager XML export, with the given policies for systems and items that already exist. Returns the systems and items it created and removed.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.6.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ImportClassificationsXml

Parameters:

- `itemConflictPolicy` (ClassificationItemConflictPolicy, required)

Returns:

- `executionResult` (ExecutionResult, required)
- `created` (array of GuidId, required)
- `removed` (array of GuidId, required)

Grasshopper: `ImportClassificationsXmlComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/ImportClassificationsXml.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/ImportClassificationsXml.py): Imports a small classification system from Classification Manager XML with ImportClassificationsXml, then deletes it. systemConflictPolicy 'skip' keeps a system whose name already exists.

### GetClassificationItemVisibility

Tells whether the given classification items are visible (offered) for the given elements, element tool defaults and attributes, such as building materials. Non-existing targets and classification items are reported as errors. Visibility does not tell whether the target is classified with the item, and an item can be visible even if its parent item is not.

Group: Classification Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetClassificationItemVisibility

Parameters:

- `targets` (array of object or object or object, required): The elements, element tool defaults and attributes to check the classification items for.
- `classificationItemIds` (ClassificationItemIds, required)

Returns:

- `classificationItemVisibilities` (array of ClassificationItemVisibilities or ErrorItem, required): One entry per target, in the order of the input. A non-existing element or attribute, or an invalid element type, is represented by an error object.

Grasshopper: `GetClassificationItemVisibilityComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationItemVisibility.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Classification/GetClassificationItemVisibility.py): Tells whether the first item of the first classification system is offered for the first Wall, the Wall tool default and the first Building Material with GetClassificationItemVisibility. Needs at least one Wall.

## Shared schema definitions

Types that parameters and results refer to by name.

### Elements

array of ElementIdArrayItem: A list of elements.

### ElementIdArrayItem

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)

### ElementId

object: The identifier of an element.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### AttributeIds

array of AttributeIdArrayItem: A list of attributes.

### AttributeIdArrayItem

object
- `attributeId` (AttributeId, required)

### AttributeId

object: The identifier of an attribute.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### GuidId

object: Identifier.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### Guid

string: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

### Error

object: The details of an error.
- `code` (integer, required): The code of the error.
- `message` (string, required): The error message.

### ErrorItem

object
- `error` (Error, required)

### SuccessfulExecutionResult

object: The result of a successful execution.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)

### FailedExecutionResult

object: The result of a failed execution.
- `success` (boolean (false), required)
- `error` (Error, required)

### ExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of the execution.

### ExecutionResults

array of ExecutionResult: A list of execution results.

### DryRun

boolean: If true, the command makes all the checks of a real run and resolves the same targets, with the same errors, but changes nothing in the project and creates no undo step. The response is that of a real run with "dryRun": true added, and says for each target what the real run would do. Default is false.

### DryRunFlag

boolean (true): Present, and true, only in the response of a dry run (the dryRun input was true): nothing was changed in the project.

### WouldDeleteExecutionResult

object: The result of a dry run for a target that passed every check: a real run would delete it.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)
- `wouldDelete` (boolean (true), required)

### DeletionExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or WouldDeleteExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of a deletion for one target. On a dry run a target that passed every check gets wouldDelete instead of being deleted.

### DeletionExecutionResults

array of DeletionExecutionResult: A list of deletion results.

### WouldChange

object: What a real run would change on a target. Each command says what its oldValue and newValue are; either is left out when it cannot be told cheaply.
- `oldValue` (any): The target's value now, before the change.
- `newValue` (any): The value a real run would write.

### WouldChangeExecutionResult

object: The result of a dry run for a target that passed every check: a real run would change it as wouldChange says.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)
- `wouldChange` (WouldChange, required)

### ChangeExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or WouldChangeExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of a change for one target. On a dry run a target that passed every check gets wouldChange instead of being changed.

### ChangeExecutionResults

array of ChangeExecutionResult: A list of change results.

### ElementType

string ("Wall", "Column", "Beam", "Window", "Door", "Object", "Lamp", "Slab", "Roof", "Mesh", "Dimension", "RadialDimension", ...): The type of an element.

### ClassificationSystemConflictPolicy

string ("merge", "replace", "skip"): What to do with a system whose name already exists: merge, replace it, or keep the existing one.

### ClassificationItemConflictPolicy

string ("replace", "skip"): What to do with an item whose id already exists in a merged system: replace it or keep the existing one.

### ClassificationItemUpdate

object
- `classificationItemId` (ClassificationItemId, required)
- `id` (string): The new code of the item, e.g. 21.10.
- `name` (string)
- `description` (string)

### ClassificationSystemUpdate

object
- `classificationSystemId` (ClassificationSystemId, required)
- `name` (string)
- `description` (string)
- `source` (string)
- `version` (string)
- `date` (Date)

### ClassificationSystemId

object: The identifier of a classification system.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### ClassificationSystemIdArrayItem

object
- `classificationSystemId` (ClassificationSystemId, required)

### ClassificationSystemIds

array of ClassificationSystemIdArrayItem: A list of classification system identifiers.

### Date

string: A date in its string representation as defined in ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD.

### ClassificationSystemDetails

object: The details of a classification system.
- `name` (string, required): The display name of the classification system.
- `description` (string, required): The description of the classification system.
- `source` (string, required): The source of the classification system (e.g. URL to a classification system standard).
- `version` (string, required): The version of the classification system.
- `date` (Date, required): The release date of the classification system's current version.

### ClassificationItemDetails

object: The details of a classification item.
- `id` (string, required): The unique identifier of the classification item as specified by the user.
- `name` (string, required): The display name of the classification item.
- `description` (string, required): The description of the classification item.
- `children` (array of ClassificationItemDetails): A list of classification items.

### ClassificationSystemsWithItems

array of object: Classification systems with items.

### NewClassificationItems

array of object: Classification systems with items.

### ClassificationItemId

object: The identifier of a classification item.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### ClassificationItemIdArrayItem

object
- `classificationItemId` (ClassificationItemId, required)

### ClassificationItemIds

array of ClassificationItemIdArrayItem: A list of classification item identifiers.

### ClassificationId

object: The element classification identifier.
- `classificationSystemId` (ClassificationSystemId, required)
- `classificationItemId` (ClassificationItemId): The element's classification in the given system. If no value is specified here, the element is Unclassified in this system.

### ClassificationIdArrayItem

object: A wrapper containing the classification identifier.
- `classificationId` (ClassificationId, required)

### ClassificationIdOrError

ClassificationIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A classification identifier or an error.

### ClassificationSystemIdOrError

ClassificationSystemIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A classification system identifier or an error.

### ClassificationSystemIdsOrErrors

array of ClassificationSystemIdOrError: A list of classification system identifiers or errors.

### ClassificationItemIdOrError

ClassificationItemIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A classification item identifier or an error.

### ClassificationItemIdsOrErrors

array of ClassificationItemIdOrError: A list of classification item identifiers or errors.

### ClassificationIdsOrErrors

array of ClassificationIdOrError: A list of element classification identifiers or errors.

### ClassificationItemElements

object
- `elements` (Elements, required)

### AttributeClassifications

object
- `classificationIds` (array of ClassificationId, required): The classification of the attribute in every classification system it is classified in.

### AttributeClassification

object
- `attributeId` (AttributeId, required)
- `classificationId` (ClassificationId, required): The classification to set. The item replaces the attribute's current item in the same classification system. If the classificationItemId field is omitted, the attribute becomes unclassified in the given system.

### ToolDefaultClassifications

object
- `classificationIds` (array of ClassificationId, required): One item for each classification system in which the tool default is classified. Systems in which it is unclassified are left out.

### ClassificationSystemSummary

object
- `classificationSystemId` (ClassificationSystemId, required)
- `name` (string, required): The display name of the classification system.
- `description` (string, required): The description of the classification system.
- `source` (string, required): The source of the classification system (e.g. URL to a classification system standard).
- `version` (string, required): The version of the classification system.
- `date` (Date, required): The release date of the classification system's current version.

### ClassificationItemParent

object
- `classificationSystemId` (ClassificationSystemId, required): The classification system the item belongs to.
- `parentClassificationItemId` (ClassificationItemId): The parent item. Missing for a top level item of its system.

### ClassificationItemVisibilities

object
- `visibilities` (array of ClassificationItemVisibility or ErrorItem, required): One entry per classification item, in the order of the input. A non-existing classification item is represented by an error object.

### ClassificationItemVisibility

object
- `classificationItemId` (ClassificationItemId, required)
- `isVisible` (boolean, required): Whether the classification item is visible (offered) for the target, as Archicad reports it. It can be true even if a parent item is not visible. It does not tell whether the target is classified with the item.

### ElementClassificationItemArray

object: A wrapper containing a list of element classification identifiers or errors.
